name: Jason Duval
body: Grew up around grifters and crooks before serving in the Army, then came home to the Keys to work for local drug runners. Meeting Lucia changes his trajectory — the two can take on jobs together or go their separate ways.
imageCaption: Robbing a store in Vice City

name: Lucia Caminos
body: The series' first female lead. Trained to fight from a young age, she served time at Leonida Penitentiary after fighting for her family, and wants to build the life her mother always wanted — through careful, deliberate plans rather than chaos.

name: Brian Heder
body: A veteran Keys drug runner. Lets Jason live rent-free at one of his properties in exchange for help with local shakedowns, and runs a boat yard with his wife Lori.
imageCaption: Alone in a Vice City establishment

name: Cal Hampton
body: Jason's friend — a conspiracy-minded homebody who monitors Coast Guard radio for kicks. Content with a quiet life while Jason has bigger plans.

name: Lori
body: Brian's third wife. Helps run the boat yard alongside him, and is known locally for her sangria.

name: Boobie Ike
body: A Vice City businessman who built a legitimate empire — real estate, the Jack of Hearts strip club, and a recording studio. Partners with Dre'Quan Priest at Only Raw Records, chasing a hit.
imageCaption: Alone inside the Jack of Hearts club

name: Dre'Quan Priest
body: An aspiring music mogul, "more of a hustler than a gangster." Started out booking acts at Boobie's club and signed Real Dimez to Only Raw Records.

name: Raul Bautista
body: A seasoned, charming bank robber who recruits talented risk-takers for jobs. His recklessness raises the stakes every time.
imageCaption: Driving away with a bag of money

name: Real Dimez (Bae-Luxe & Roxy)
body: A rapper-influencer duo, friends since high school, who built a following through tracks and social media. Scored an early hit with local rapper DWNPLY before getting signed to Only Raw Records.
imageCaption: Dancing on an Obey luxury vehicle

name: DWNPLY
body: A local rapper and early collaborator with Real Dimez on one of their first tracks.
